acceptanceCriteria.text: Decide and document one authoritative contract for the OpenSSH client tooling required by the selected Lima profile: explicit Route 4 precondition with bounded validation, or managed/provisioned Route 4 dependency.
`mottainai-init` checks/establishes that contract before mutating/starting the Route 3 Lima instance.
Missing `ssh` and missing `ssh-keygen` fail early with stable bounded actionable diagnostics rather than surfacing as late Lima readiness failures.
The selected SSH/key-generation authority composes with #840's MTNAI_BOOT key delivery and does not adopt ambient `~/.ssh` credentials.
Regression coverage exercises a host environment with OpenSSH tools absent from PATH and proves the declared behavior.
Route 4 documentation and #261 starting conditions are updated so the certified fresh-host preconditions exactly match the implementation.
No shell/package-manager dependency is added implicitly to the standalone Rust bootstrap path.

issue.title: fix(runtime): close the implicit OpenSSH dependency in the Route 4 fresh-host contract
